_comment: Single source of truth for ETF system thresholds. Python reads this directly via etf_screener.py. Pine surfaces (dashboard, strategy) reference these values manually via input defaults -- keep in sync if edited. Last updated: 12 May 2026.
_benchmark_note: Nifty 500. Locked universally; previously per-ETF substitution was a bug.
_liq_min_cr_note: ILLIQUID threshold in Rs Cr/day median turnover. Below this, ETF cannot trigger BUY-LEADER and is force-exited if held.
_stage2_slope_note: 200-DMA slope minimum (% over 20 sessions) to qualify for Stage 2.
_buy_leader_note: Liquidity score threshold for BUY-LEADER signal. Score 6 maps to >= Rs 2 Cr/day.

correlation_gate._note: 60-day daily-return correlation. Drops top-pick candidates that correlate >= 0.75 with an already-accepted pick.

rotation_engine._note: Composite RS = 0.6 * 12W excess rank + 0.4 * 4W excess rank.

backtest_defaults._note: Locked from 12 May 2026 sensitivity audit. Monthly + Top-N=8 gave Sharpe 1.52 with max DD -6.02% vs weekly's -11.77% -- same alpha at half the drawdown and 1/4 the trades.

_min_hold_note: Minimum holding period in calendar days. Prevents over-rotation (MAFANG had 245 trades over 6.35y baseline). Stage-4 / liquidity-collapse exits override this gate.
